description: List all tracked credit card benefits with current period status, amounts, and expiry dates. This includes statement credits, free night certificates, companion certs, lounge passes, and all other card-linked benefits. For standalone items NOT tied to a card (gift cards, vouchers, travel credits), use list_rewards instead. Filter by status (unused/partial/used), card nickname, or expiring within N days.

card_id.description: Filter by exact card ID (from list_cards). Takes precedence over `card` nickname filter.

expiring_within_days.description: Only return benefits expiring within this many days

name: list_benefits
